experiments.name: ALU-path chain
experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 800 --unroll2 1600 --iters 40 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1088; li.d $r22, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r22; li.d $r4, 8; st.w $r4, $r20, 0; li.d $r4, 0; st.w $r4, $r20, 8; li.d $r13, 0' --asm 'ldptr.w $r4, $r20, 0; add.d $r20, $r20, $r4'

latencies.notes: The word form zero-extends its 32-bit result, so it cannot close a pointer chase; the ALU chain measures 5.94 cycles, of which 2 are the add.d plus the ALU consumer cycle, leaving the 4-cycle load latency. ldptr.d does close a chase and measures 4 directly.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: ldptr.w $r12, $r20, 0; ldptr.w $r13, $r20, 8; ldptr.w $r14, $r20, 16; ldptr.w $r15, $r20, 24; ldptr.w $r16, $r20, 32; ldptr.w $r17, $r20, 40; ldptr.w $r18, $r20, 48; ldptr.w $r19, $r20, 56
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024' --asm 'ldptr.w $r12, $r20, 0; ldptr.w $r13, $r20, 8; ldptr.w $r14, $r20, 16; ldptr.w $r15, $r20, 24; ldptr.w $r16, $r20, 32; ldptr.w $r17, $r20, 40; ldptr.w $r18, $r20, 48; ldptr.w $r19, $r20, 56'
